claim: Explicit relationships among changes, models, obligations, and evidence guide validation effort; incomplete relationships can require broader checks.
topology: Two distinct landmarks on one timeline: early honest evidence and last safe recheck; hollow/solid diamond separates roles.
bw_encoding: Light gray identifies model and obligation boxes.
redesign: Replaced the two-boundary timeline with author-supplied model-aware change-impact structure. Worker concurrency connects related execution, memory, and latency models to potentially affected obligations and required evidence. Model and obligation boxes are shaded, with no legend. Vertical flow arrows and split/join rails align on one spine. The later validation-bottleneck episode is retained.
alt: A proposed increase in worker concurrency leads through execution, memory, and latency models to legal ordering, peak-memory, and latency obligations. Correctness tests, memory analysis or measurement, and performance tests supply evidence for admission. The model and obligation boxes are shaded; all split and join rails share a central vertical spine.
